works.title: Internal Parliament Theory for AI Character Development and Spiritual Practice
works.description: A psychological framework modeling human consciousness and behavior as competing internal coalitions (selfish/selfless impulses) with consciousness functioning as a prime minister earning influence through wise decision-making. Rooted in Buddhist teachings on self-grasping and self-cherishing as root of suffering, integrated with Western psychology and AI character development. User plans a long-form teaching version as core of a book on spiritual practice.
works.quote: I want a long-form prose version I can use to teach this to others, perhaps as the core of a book on spiritual practice.
